ascensionStars.doc: How many stars a hero's ascension has.

ascensionStepsPerStar.doc: How many points make one star. Each ascension fills one point; a full star raises the level cap.

recruitFragments.doc: Fragments that recruit a hero not owned yet.

fragmentsPerStepBase.doc: Fragments one ascension asks for on the first star.

fragmentsPerStepGrowth.doc: How many times dearer in fragments each later star's ascensions are.

ascensionStardustBase.doc: Stardust one ascension asks for on the first star.

ascensionStardustGrowth.doc: How many times dearer in Stardust each later star's ascensions are.

heroLevelsPerStar.doc: Levels a full star adds to the level cap on top of its points' heroLevelsPerAscension.

heroLevelsPerAscension.doc: Levels every ascension point adds to the level cap. With no ascension the cap is heroMaxLevel minus every point's and every star's levels; every star full is heroMaxLevel.

statsPerAscension.doc: How much every ascension point adds to a hero's Attack, Defense and HP, as a share of what its level gives: 0.02 is +2% a point.

skillRankLevels.doc: The level each skill rank after the first unlocks at (ranks 2 to 5). Each sits past a star's level cap, so a rank asks for an ascension too.

skillRankStardust.doc: Stardust each skill rank after the first costs (ranks 2 to 5).

skillRankMaterial.doc: Precious material each skill rank after the first costs — the skill family's (ranks 2 to 5). Asked only once the world is open.

skillRankStep.doc: What each rank adds, as a share of the rank-1 value: 0.25 makes rank 5 twice rank 1.

firstCallsNewHero.doc: The kingdom's first calls, counted across every banner, that cannot miss and hand a hero the player does not own yet.
